# Ownership map

<!-- agent-kit: generated by /setup-agents, updated by /add-agent.
     Keep in sync with .claude/ownership.json (machine-readable copy used by the dashboard). -->

Agents edit **only** their paths. Reading anything is allowed. Paths must not overlap.

| Owner | Paths | Quick check (own area only) |
|---|---|---|
| **orchestrator** (main session) | `apkh-api/src/main.ts`, `apkh-api/src/app.module.ts`, `apkh-web/src/app/layout.tsx`, `apkh-web/src/app/providers.tsx`, `apkh-web/src/app/manifest.ts`, `apkh-search/main.py`, every `package.json` / `package-lock.json`, `apkh-search/requirements.txt`, package configs (`tsconfig*.json`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `next.config.ts`, `nest-cli.json`, `postcss.config.mjs`), `.github/**`, `deploy/**`, `scripts/**`, `docs/**`, root `*.md` and `*.bat`, `.claude/**`, git | `scripts/check.ps1` |
| **api** | `apkh-api/src/*/**` (module folders), `apkh-api/scripts/**` | `cd apkh-api && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint "src/**/*.ts"` |
| **web-ui** | `apkh-web/src/app/*/**` (route folders), `apkh-web/src/app/page.tsx`, `apkh-web/src/app/globals.css`, `apkh-web/src/components/**`, `apkh-web/src/i18n/**`, `apkh-web/public/**` | `cd apkh-web && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint src/app src/components src/i18n` |
| **web-data** | `apkh-web/src/services/**` (not `api-schema.d.ts`), `apkh-web/src/store/**`, `apkh-web/src/hooks/**`, `apkh-web/src/context/**`, `apkh-web/src/models/**`, `apkh-web/src/lib/**` | `cd apkh-web && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint src/services src/store src/hooks src/context src/models src/lib` |
| **search** | `apkh-search/routes/**`, `apkh-search/services/**` | `cd apkh-search && .venv/Scripts/python -m compileall -q main.py routes services && JWT_SECRET=ci-only BUILTIN_AI=off .venv/Scripts/python -c "import main"` |
| **satellites** | `apkh-storage/server.js`, `apkh-storage/scripts/**`, `apkh-mcp/src/**`, `apkh-mcp/scripts/**`, `apkh-clipper/**` | `node --check apkh-storage/server.js && (cd apkh-mcp && npx tsc --noEmit)` |
| **reviewer** (read-only) | — | — |
| **security-reviewer** (read-only) | — | — |
| **generated** (nobody edits) | `apkh-api/openapi.json`, `apkh-web/src/services/api-schema.d.ts`, `apkh-api/dist/**`, `apkh-web/.next/**`, `apkh-mcp/dist/**` | regenerate with `scripts/codegen.ps1` |
| **user data** (nobody edits) | `apkh-storage/uploads/**`, `.env` files | — |

Generated files win over an agent glob that also matches them (`api-schema.d.ts` sits in web-data's `services/` folder but is generated).

## Shared boundaries
- **api ↔ web-data** (HTTP API). The api agent writes controllers and DTO classes; web-data writes `src/services/*Service.ts`. Request bodies are pinned by the DTO class names in the plan: the orchestrator writes DTO skeletons and runs `scripts/codegen.ps1`, then web-data uses `ApiBody<"DtoName">`. Response shapes aren't in `openapi.json` yet, so the plan's **Shared names** pins each response as a TypeScript interface; web-data declares it, api returns exactly that.
- **web-data ↔ web-ui** (in-app). web-data exposes service functions, hooks (`useX` with a pinned return shape), Redux slice actions/selectors and model types; web-ui only consumes them. The plan lists each name and signature. i18n keys are web-ui's; web-data returns error keys/messages via `lib/localizedError.ts`.
- **api ↔ search** (internal HTTP). The api agent changes `apkh-api/src/search-api/search-api.client.ts`; the search agent changes `apkh-search/routes/*`. The plan pins route path, method, and the request/response fields (snake_case JSON) on both sides. New routers are registered in `main.py` by the orchestrator.
- **api ↔ satellites** (storage and MCP). Storage HTTP routes in `apkh-storage/server.js` are called from `apkh-api/src/file/file.service.ts`; MCP tools in `apkh-mcp/src/tools/*` call `/integrations/*` routes in `apkh-api/src/integrations/`. The plan pins paths, query params, bodies, token scopes and response fields.
- **search ↔ satellites** (attachments). `apkh-search` downloads attachments from storage with the JWT it receives; any change to storage download URLs is pinned in the plan for both.
- **web-ui ↔ orchestrator**. New global providers or root layout changes (`app/layout.tsx`, `app/providers.tsx`) go through "Needs from orchestrator".

## Build collisions
Parallel builds can lock output folders. If a quick check fails with a "file in use"/lock error, wait briefly and retry once; if it still fails, report it and stop — don't loop. Quick checks use `tsc --noEmit` so they never write `dist/` or `.next/`.
